title: Asymptotic properties of random monomial ideals
summary: This paper focuses on asymptotic properties of random monomial ideals through a statistical viewpoint. It extends the study of redundancy in monomial ideals by analyzing the poset density of the LCM-lattice. We explore how this density behaves across random algebraic models and structured networks. Experimental data reveal that the LCM-lattice exhibits sharp threshold behavior rather than changing smoothly.
